name: Audio analysis
description: Measured facts about an audio file — loudness, clipping, tempo, silence. No model involved, so nothing is invented.

presets.label: Analyse audio
presets.description: Duration, format, loudness (EBU R128), true peak and clipping, levels, tempo, silences

presets.label: Tempo (BPM)
presets.description: Beat interval analysis. Says so plainly when there is no steady beat instead of inventing one.

presets.label: Loudness & clipping
presets.description: Integrated loudness in LUFS, loudness range, true peak, and whether it clips

presets.label: Find silences
presets.description: Stretches quieter than -45 dB for over 0.8s — where a recording actually starts and ends

presets.label: Transcribe lyrics (best effort)
presets.description: Runs whisper over the track. Singing with backing music transcribes poorly — treat the result as a draft, not a transcript.
